ground_truth.title: Extra Thick Yoga and Pilates Mat
ground_truth.main_content:
Struggling with discomfort in your knees, elbows, or wrists during yoga or Pilates? The ProsourceFit Extra Thick Yoga & Pilates Mat—now available in both 1-inch and ½-inch thicknesses—is designed to take the pressure off your joints so you can move freely and confidently. Crafted from high-density foam, each ultra-supportive mat delivers the cushioning you need for a more comfortable, focused practice.

Choose between 1-inch or ½-inch of premium cushioning to suit your comfort level. Ideal for hard floors and sensitive joints, the mat features a high-density, non-slip surface that keeps you stable through every pose. Built for lasting durability and support, it outperforms standard mats in both quality and comfort. Available in 8 vibrant colors and includes a free yoga mat carrying sling for easy travel and storage.

- Ideal for Pilates, Yoga, and floor exercises
- 71-in x 24-in and available in 1-in (25mm) or ½-in (13mm) thickness of luxurious comfort foam
- Constructed of high-density foam for performance and durability
- Moisture-resistant NBR foam makes cleaning easy
- Non-slip surface provides extra stability
- Comes with a free yoga mat carrying sling

Specifications

Measurements:
- 1-inch: 71"L x 24"W x 1"H
- ½-inch: 71"L x 24"W x ½H

Weight:
- 1-inch: 4.5 lb
- ½-inch: 2.55 lb

Material: NBR Foam

Care: Wipe mat with a wet cloth or sponge. Allow plenty of time to dry. This mat is not machine washable.
